scope: Five priority missing works for each of the 13 recent-preacher authors discussed. Editorial acquisition priorities, not an objective bestseller ranking. Multi-volume works count as one work.

authors.author: John Piper
books: Foundational account of Christian joy and worship.
Major missions theology connecting worship and evangelism.
Faith, obedience and the promises of God.
Substantial treatment of divine sovereignty and suffering.

authors.author: R. C. Sproul
books: Foundational account of God's holiness and human response.
Accessible explanation of election and grace.
Historical treatment of the human will and salvation.

authors.author: J. I. Packer
books: Evangelism and the Sovereignty of God
Connects divine sovereignty with evangelistic responsibility.
Puritan theology, ministry and Christian experience.
Keep in Step with the Spirit
Sanctification and the work of the Holy Spirit.
Fundamentalism and the Word of God

authors.author: Martyn Lloyd-Jones
books: Pastoral application of doctrine to spiritual discouragement.
Studies in the Sermon on the Mount
Sustained exposition and Christian ethics; editions may combine two volumes.
Collected doctrinal lectures; preserve volume/edition relationships.
Church renewal, prayer and the work of the Spirit.

authors.author: John Murray
books: Substantial exegesis; preserve the two-volume and combined editions.
Four-volume work containing lectures, essays and sermons; index component genres.
Important Presbyterian argument; preserve disagreement with Baptist authors.

authors.author: Sinclair Ferguson
books: Substantial biblical and theological treatment of the Spirit.
Introductory doctrine connected to Christian experience.

authors.author: D. A. Carson
books: Major engagement with pluralism and Christian truth claims.
Biblical theology and practice of prayer; earlier title A Call to Spiritual Reformation.
Exegesis of sovereignty and responsibility, especially in John.

authors.author: Alistair Begg
books: Accessible instruction in prayer from Ephesians.
Daniel applied to faithful life in a secular culture.
Christian application of the Ten Commandments.
Providence and the life of Joseph.

authors.author: John MacArthur
books: Influential presentation of saving faith and discipleship.
The Gospel According to the Apostles
Companion treatment of faith and works; originally Faith Works.
Ministry methodology and the church's message.
Major systematic theology coedited with Richard Mayhue; retain contributors.
The believer's identity and allegiance to Christ.

authors.author: Billy Graham
books: Signature evangelistic explanation of the Christian gospel.
Autobiographical primary source for twentieth-century evangelism.
Widely read treatment of a less-covered doctrine.

authors.author: Adrian Rogers
books: What Every Christian Ought to Know
The Incredible Power of Kingdom Authority
Prayer, spiritual conflict and Christian authority.
Ten Secrets for a Successful Family
Unveiling the End Times in Our Time
Pastoral application to anger, fear and emotional life; distinguish the book from its study series.

authors.author: W. A. Criswell
books: Why I Preach That the Bible Is Literally True
Sustained sermon collection; preserve volume relationships.
Doctrinal sermon series in book form; identify each volume.
With a Bible in My Hand

authors.author: J. Vernon McGee
books: Complete commentary set; five-volume and sixty-volume editions must not be counted as distinct works.
Pastoral help for suffering and grief; individual booklets are not the full volume.
Representative prophetic interpretation; preserve author distinctives.
